summary: Iteration 4 testing complete: 'My next trip' widget feature. All core functionality works correctly. Widget renders when confirmed upcoming booking exists, hides when no bookings/only past/only pending. Countdown tiles show valid 2-digit numeric values. QR code, View ticket link, and Add to calendar (.ics download) all work. CRITICAL DESIGN BUG: Widget has white text on white background due to CSS specificity issue (.te-card overrides bg-black).

ui_bugs.issue: Widget countdown numbers and text are invisible - white text on white background. The .te-card CSS class (background: white) overrides the Tailwind bg-black class due to CSS specificity.
ui_bugs.fix_suggestion: Remove 'te-card' class from NextTripWidget.jsx line 96, or add inline style={{backgroundColor: 'black'}} to override, or use !important in Tailwind class

issues: Countdown numbers (DAYS, HOURS, MINS, SECS) not visible due to white-on-white contrast
Route info and other text in widget also affected by same issue
